{{Quote|On the Mid Rim world of Chalacta, Senator Yudrish Sedran has consulted the Chalactan Temple of Illumination for direction, adopting a strong anti-Military Creation Act stance that has been anecdotally supported by Chalactan Jedi Depa Billaba and Sar Labooda.|HoloNet News|<ref name="HNN55" />}}
'''Yudrish Sedran''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chalacta/Legends|Chalacta]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Senator Sedran sought guidance from the [[Temple of Illumination]], which led Sedran to oppose the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] that was soon to be brought before the Senate for a vote. Sedran's position was reported in [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] Vol. 531 #55 one week prior to the decision, with the article noting that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] and [[Sar Labooda/Legends|Sar Labooda]] were believed to share his opposition.

==Biography==
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Yudrish Sedran served as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] representing [[Chalacta/Legends|Chalacta]] in the Galactic Republic Senate. As the Senate prepared to vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], Sedran consulted the [[Temple of Illumination]] on the senator's homeworld for guidance. Following this counsel, Senator Sedran adopted a public stance against the proposed legislation. The senator's opposition was noted in [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] Vol. 531 #55, which was published one week before the vote. The article additionally reported that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] and [[Sar Labooda/Legends|Sar Labooda]] were believed to share Senator Sedran's position.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="HNN55" />

Although little else was recorded about Yudrish Sedran's career, the senator's opposition to the Military Creation Act was noted as part of the broader political debate within the Republic during the Separatist Crisis. Sedran's stance was preserved in HoloNet News coverage from the period, alongside references to support from Jedi associated with Chalacta. This record placed Sedran among the senators remembered for voicing resistance to the growing militarization of the Republic in the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN55" />

==Personality==
Yudrish Sedran was guided in political matters by the teachings of the [[Temple of Illumination]] on [[Chalacta/Legends|Chalacta]], reflecting a reliance on spiritual and philosophical counsel when navigating major decisions. Sedran demonstrated a willingness to take a principled stance against the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], even as many in the Senate were divided over the issue. The senator's position suggested a cautious outlook toward militarization and an inclination to seek wisdom beyond political debate before reaching conclusions.<ref name="HNN55" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yudrish Sedran was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #55'']],<ref name="HNN55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_1.html|Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim}}</ref> a [[May 10]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN55 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6774521|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-05-10|time=12:55 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220611192020/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-14}}</ref> issue published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website.<ref name="HNN55" /> The article was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
